purpose: Extend exact satellite-provider eligibility from Phase167's 22 new records to 194 high-value existing Device Passport records, preserving purchase-source, platform-region, feature-level and evidence boundaries.

cohort_definition.selection_reason: Current/high-value consumer devices with explicit current official carrier satellite compatibility coverage.

apple_messages.scope: Apple-native Messages via satellite: iPhone 14+ all models, Japan and conditions

google_satellite_sos.scope: Satellite SOS: all Pixel devices since Pixel 9 except Pixel 9a; Japan absent from supported regions

au_devices.scope: au Starlink Direct, separated by au/UQ purchase source vs other-company purchase source

docomo_other.scope: models purchased outside docomo and feature level

docomo_software.scope: current software-version conditions for supported models

softbank.scope: SoftBank/Y!mobile vs other-purchased device lists, feature level, Free Style exclusion

rakuten_apple.scope: Rakuten support for Apple satellite messaging

rakuten_ast.scope: AST SpaceMobile Q4 2026 target; not launched at check date

evidence_boundaries: Purchase-source tabs are preserved; same model name sold by another carrier is not automatically promoted.
Apple-native satellite is separate from carrier-provided Starlink Direct.
Google Pixel Satellite SOS hardware eligibility remains separate from regional availability; Japan remains unavailable at checked_at.
Pixel 9a is excluded from Google Satellite SOS but may be carrier-satellite messaging-capable.
Carrier data+message support does not imply voice calling or direct emergency calling.
not_listed means current official list did not confirm the record's purchase-source path; it is not a permanent hardware impossibility claim.
No Phase168 mapping creates SolQvia real-device satellite evidence.
